qa.title: Q2360 (Sep. 10, 2026)
qa.question: During my turn, if there are 2 copies of this follower on my field, can I choose the same option for both automatic ability triggers when I play a Loot card?
qa.answer: Yes, you can. However, you cannot choose that option again later in the turn if another Loot card is played.

qa.title: Q2401 (Sep. 10, 2026)
qa.question: I have this follower and an Enstatued Seraph with 3 prayer counters on my field. Will my leader gain 20 defense at the start of my end phase from Enstatued Seraph's "At the start of your end phase" ability?
qa.answer: No, it will gain 10 defense. Enstatued Seraph's ability will trigger again, but since Enstatued Seraph was buried as part of the first activation, the second activation cannot be resolved.

qa.title: Q2387 (Sep. 10, 2026)

qa.answer: Yes. You would simply not refresh the follower.
